verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents RAG over local and remote documents, @-mentioned files fed to the AI as context, and in-browser Python execution, so users can get AI-generated answers grounded in their own data inside the product. Community users report RAG failing in no-GPU, external-API-only setups, which caps quality but does not contradict the capability in general. Missing for 10: proactive or automatic insight and suggestion surfacing (everything evidenced is user-prompted), dedicated data-analysis or insight features, and independent corroboration that data-grounded answers work reliably across deployment configurations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: RAG can retrieve and incorporate the relevant information from that source into the chat response.
retrieving relevant information from a wide range of sources such as local and remote documents, web content, and even multimedia sources like YouTube videos.
@ mentions a file; its content is fed to the AI as context.
Run Python directly in the browser or via Open Terminal
